pressure_hypothesis.title: Recorded CLI projection results receive conflicting source integrity statuses
pressure_hypothesis.basis: After the source status recognized direct-cli-projection-result as captured in its containing record, the separate content-integrity projection still classified that same source kind as invalid because it used a different allowlist.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Use one explicit set of captured operation-result kinds for both source status and content-integrity status; retain captured-in-record semantics without claiming independent byte verification.
